info.description:
# ðŸ§ª CASMI 2026 Reference Assets: Natural Products & Tandem Mass Spectra

## ðŸ“Œ Context & Overview
This dataset contains curated reference libraries and empirical tandem mass spectra (MS/MS) specifically engineered for the **Enveda CASMI 2026 Molecule Identification Challenge**.

Accurate de novo and database-assisted small molecule identification from high-resolution collision-induced dissociation (CID) spectra requires high-quality structural prior libraries and curated spectral repositories. This collection aggregates over 1,000,000 canonical natural product scaffolds and 300,000+ reference tandem mass spectra across multiple collision energies.

---

## ðŸ“‚ File Inventory & Schema Details

### 1. `train_unique_molecules.parquet`
- **Description**: Canonicalized, deduplicated molecular structures extracted from the CASMI 2026 training partition.
- **Rows**: ~45,000 unique molecular entities.
- **Columns**:
  - `normalized_smiles` (*string*): Standardized, stereo-sanitized RDKit canonical SMILES string.
  - `exact_mass` (*float64*): Monoisotopic neutral mass computed via IUPAC atomic weight standards ($^{12}\text{C}=12.000000$, $^{1}\text{H}=1.007825$, $^{16}\text{O}=15.994915$, $^{14}\text{N}=14.003074$).
  - `formula` (*string*): Stoichiometric elemental Hill formula (e.g. `C18H16O7`).

### 2. `coconut_natural_products.parquet`
- **Description**: Curated collection of natural products from the **COre Open NatUral producTs (COCONUT)** database.
- **Rows**: 1,015,089 natural product candidates.
- **Columns**:
  - `smiles` (*string*): Canonical SMILES representation of the natural metabolite.
  - `exact_mass` (*float64*): Exact monoisotopic neutral mass in Daltons.
  - `coconut_id` (*string*): Unique COCONUT access identifier (e.g., `CNP0123456`).

### 3. `reference_np_library.parquet`
- **Description**: 302,745 experimental and reference MS/MS spectra matched to verified chemical structures.
- **Sources**: GNPS (Global Natural Products Social Molecular Networking), MassBank of North America (MoNA), and Enveda reference standards.
- **Columns**:
  - `normalized_smiles` (*string*): Ground-truth chemical structure.
  - `neutral_mass` (*float64*): Neutral precursor mass ($m/z$ corrected for adduct ion).
  - `curated_mzs` (*list[float64]*): Deisotoped, intensity-thresholded fragment $m/z$ array.
  - `curated_intensities` (*list[float64]*): Sqrt-scaled, base-peak normalized relative intensities ($[0.0, 1.0]$).
  - `ingest_lib` (*string*): Provenance source repository tag (`enveda-np-examples`, `gnps-curated`, `mona-np`).

---

## ðŸ”¬ Methodology & Data Preprocessing
1. **High-Resolution Deisotoping**: Secondary $^{13}\text{C}$ isotope satellites ($+1.003355\text{ Da}$) were detected and deconvolved within $\Delta m \le 0.015\text{ Da}$ tolerance.
2. **Dynamic Range Floor**: Low-intensity chemical noise below $0.5\%$ of base peak intensity was stripped.
3. **Spectral Merging**: Multi-collision energy spectra ($10\text{ eV}, 20\text{ eV}, 40\text{ eV}$) were merged via intensity-weighted centroid clustering.
4. **Canonical Stereochemistry**: All structures were normalized using RDKit InChI / SMILES canonicalization routines.

---
